hooks.prompt: A new pull request was just created. Launch the use-reviewers skill to initiate code review with 2 independent reviewers based on the PR's focus area. Use Dr. Alice Chen (Correctness & Type Safety) + Marcus Rodriguez (Security & Performance) as the default reviewer pair for most PRs, unless the PR is primarily frontend-focused (use Evan Brooks) or backend/data-focused (use Sam Okoro). Review the PR diff, extract the changed files, and prepare the reviewer prompts with the exact PR number and file list from the PR details.
